Oliver —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the attachments. A couple of items from our side before we kick off verification and schedule first payout:

1) Bank validation: can you add a voided check or bank letter (scanned) to the thread? Our payment processor requires either a voided check or a bank letter that includes the account holder name and routing number. If you attach a JPG/PDF that will work.

2) W-9/EIN: thank you — we received the W-9. Please confirm the EIN that appears on the form (we redact public posting but need exact EIN for tax vendor record).

3) Remittance formatting: Redwood requires the PO number in the remittance string exactly as: PO: 5779. For invoice tagging we request the invoice includes: Redwood PO 5779 | Goldleaf Inc. | Invoice <invoice-number>. Can you confirm your invoices will include that field?

4) Micro-deposit test: for ACH we run micro-deposits (two small amounts) to validate the account. If you confirm we have permission to initiate micro-deposits we will start that today; confirmation from your AP team that they will verify amounts is sufficient.

For your convenience I attached a one-page sample CSV we import for remittance parsing — please format the invoice export to match the columns where possible (PO, Invoice Number, Gross Amount, Remit Email).

Once we have the voided check and EIN confirmation I will kick to finance (Priyom) to initiate micro-deposits and finalize vendor record.

Thanks — Camila
Camila Reyes
Vendor Enablement | Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference
